name: Zhejiang Haiyan Power System Resources Environmental Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Zhejiang Haiyan Power System Resources Environmental Technology Co.,Ltd., founded in 2014 and based in Jiaxing, China, is an enterprise focused on the development, design, and integration of advanced water treatment systems. These solutions cater to a broad spectrum of clients, including nuclear and thermal power stations, metallurgical and chemical industries, other industrial facilities, and municipal sectors. Beyond water management, the company also provides smart power plant solutions to electricity providers. Their offerings further extend to specialized equipment like condensate polishing systems, vital for industrial water recycling, along with demineralized water systems and essential relays for power generation and transformation units.
